command: git fetch -q origin main; git show origin/main:package.json | grep -E '"(name|version)"'; echo ----; npm view approval-md version 2>&1 | tail -1; echo ----; git show origin/main:SPEC.md | grep -o "pending sign-off" | wc -l; echo "(SPEC amendments awaiting sign-off)"; echo ----; gh pr list --state open --limit 30 --json number,title,mergeStateStatus -q '.[] | "\(.number) \(.mergeStateStatus) \(.title)"' | grep -v "Log advance"
